identity_summary: All four documents (Protocol, ICF, IB, CRF) identify trial 2012-0001 with compatible titles and a coherent version chronology (Protocol v3.1 -> ICF v2.0 -> CRF v1.4, IB Edition 4). Mapping was permitted.

documents.title: Phase III Study of BI-2050 in Adults with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
documents.identity_evidence: Protocol No. 2012-0001; Phase III; Version 3.1 stated on the cover page and running header

documents.title: Participant Information and Informed Consent Form
documents.identity_evidence: Study 2012-0001 stated in the ICF header and consent signature block

documents.title: BI-2050 Investigator's Brochure
documents.identity_evidence: BI-2050 program code and protocol cross-reference (2012-0001) present on the title page

documents.title: 2012-0001 Annotated Case Report Form
documents.identity_evidence: Trial number present in the CRF cover sheet and form footer
documents.limitations: One Laboratory Form page was low-resolution and required OCR; the central laboratory collection procedure record could not be fully extracted.

records.protocol_assertion: Adults aged 18 to 75 years with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and HbA1c 7.0%-10.5%
records.downstream_assertion: You may join if you are between 18 and 75 years old, have Type 2 Diabetes, and your HbA1c is between 7.0% and 10.5%
records.downstream_anchor: ICF Section 3.2, Who Can Take Part
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact (age range, diagnosis, HbA1c range) are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: BI-2050 250 mg administered orally once daily with food
records.downstream_assertion: You will take one 250 mg tablet by mouth once a day with a meal
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Hypoglycemia risk increases when BI-2050 is combined with sulfonylureas; dose reduction of the concomitant sulfonylurea is required
records.downstream_assertion: Low blood sugar may occur, especially if you take other diabetes medicines
records.rationale: Concept is present, but the specific sulfonylurea interaction and required dose-reduction action are not stated at the same level of detail as the Protocol.
records.recommended_action: Add explicit sulfonylurea dose-reduction guidance to the ICF risk section.

records.protocol_assertion: Participants may withdraw consent at any time without penalty or loss of benefits
records.downstream_assertion: Taking part is voluntary. You may stop at any time without penalty or losing any benefits you are entitled to
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Coded study data will be retained for a minimum of 25 years per applicable regulation
records.downstream_assertion: Not located
records.rationale: The in-scope Protocol requirement for the 25-year retention period was not located anywhere in the ICF privacy section.
records.recommended_action: Add the 25-year data retention statement to the next controlled ICF version.

records.protocol_assertion: A 24-hour emergency contact number for the site must be provided to participants
records.downstream_assertion: You can call this 24-hour number any time if you have a medical emergency related to the study: [Site Phone]
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Not applicable
records.downstream_assertion: Participants will also complete an optional wearable glucose sensor sub-study with continuous monitoring for 14 days
records.rationale: The downstream statement describes an optional sub-study procedure that has no explicit basis anywhere in the Protocol.
records.recommended_action: Confirm whether this sub-study is Protocol-approved; if so, add it to the Protocol, or remove it from the ICF.

records.protocol_assertion: Primary endpoint is change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 26
records.downstream_assertion: The study will look at how your blood sugar control changes over time
records.rationale: Evidence is present but vague; it is unclear whether 'over time' corresponds specifically to the Week 26 primary endpoint timepoint stated in the Protocol.
records.recommended_action: Verify with the medical writer whether the ICF purpose statement is intended to reference the Week 26 primary endpoint.

records.protocol_assertion: Recommended Phase III dose is 250 mg orally once daily based on Phase II dose-ranging results
records.downstream_assertion: Clinical pharmacology studies support a once-daily oral dose of 250 mg based on Phase II dose-ranging data
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Hepatotoxicity is an identified risk requiring monthly liver function monitoring for the first 6 months
records.downstream_assertion: Transient liver enzyme elevations have been observed in nonclinical studies; monthly LFT monitoring is recommended for the first 6 months of treatment
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent via clinical synonym.

records.protocol_assertion: Terminal half-life is approximately 14 hours, supporting once-daily dosing
records.downstream_assertion: Mean terminal half-life ranged from 10 to 18 hours across dose cohorts
records.rationale: Concept is present, but the Protocol's single approximate value (14 hours) differs from the wider IB range (10-18 hours) without reconciliation.
records.recommended_action: Reconcile the Protocol's single half-life estimate with the IB's reported range, or cite the specific population used.

records.protocol_assertion: Dose interruption is required for ALT or AST elevation greater than 3x ULN
records.downstream_assertion: Dosing should be interrupted if ALT or AST exceeds 3 times the upper limit of normal
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Embryo-fetal toxicity risk based on animal reproduction studies; effective contraception required during treatment and for 30 days after the last dose
records.downstream_assertion: Not located
records.rationale: The in-scope Protocol requirement describing embryo-fetal toxicity risk and the 30-day post-treatment contraception window was not located in the IB.
records.recommended_action: Add the reproductive toxicity findings and the contraception window to the next IB edition.

records.protocol_assertion: BI-2050 is primarily eliminated via renal excretion; no dose adjustment required for mild renal impairment
records.downstream_assertion: Renal excretion is the primary elimination pathway; no dose adjustment is needed in subjects with mild renal impairment
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Not applicable
records.downstream_assertion: Nonclinical carcinogenicity studies are ongoing and are expected to conclude after database lock
records.rationale: The IB references ongoing carcinogenicity studies with no corresponding statement or acknowledgment in the Protocol.
records.recommended_action: Confirm this disclosure aligns with the current Protocol version or update the Protocol's nonclinical summary section.

records.protocol_assertion: Key secondary endpoint includes change from baseline in the Diabetes Quality-of-Life (DQoL) questionnaire at Week 26
records.downstream_assertion: Not applicable — endpoint definitions are outside the scope of the Investigator's Brochure
records.rationale: Endpoint definitions are a Protocol/CRF concern; the IB is not expected to restate clinical endpoint criteria, so this comparison is out of scope for this document.
records.recommended_action: No action required; confirm endpoint-definition consistency against the CRF and Protocol only.

records.protocol_assertion: Primary endpoint is change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 26
records.downstream_assertion: HbA1c value (%) collected at Baseline and Week 26
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Confirmed diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus for at least 6 months prior to screening
records.downstream_assertion: Date of T2DM diagnosis (must be ≥6 months before Screening)
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Actual dose administered, start date/time, and any interruptions must be recorded at every visit
records.downstream_assertion: Dose administered (mg), administration start time, interruption Y/N and reason
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Adverse events must be graded per CTCAE v5.0 and tracked from first dose through 30 days after the last dose
records.downstream_assertion: Adverse event term, start/stop date, severity grade, and relationship to study drug
records.rationale: Concept is present, but the CRF field does not explicitly reference CTCAE v5.0 grading criteria or the 30-day post-treatment collection window stated in the Protocol.
records.recommended_action: Add a CTCAE v5.0 grading reference and confirm the collection window field captures the full 30-day post-treatment period.

records.protocol_assertion: PK sampling at pre-dose and 2, 4, and 8 hours post-dose on Day 1
records.downstream_assertion: PK sample collection time points: pre-dose, 2h, 4h, 8h (Day 1)
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Primary reason for treatment discontinuation must be selected from a controlled list, including a free-text field for 'Other'
records.downstream_assertion: Not located
records.rationale: The End of Treatment form captures a discontinuation date but does not include the controlled reason list or free-text 'Other' field required by the Protocol.
records.recommended_action: Add the controlled discontinuation-reason list and free-text field to the End of Treatment CRF form.

records.protocol_assertion: CRF fields must not capture directly identifying participant information; only the assigned subject ID is used
records.downstream_assertion: Subject ID (assigned); no name, date of birth, or contact information fields present
records.rationale: Concept and every relevant fact are explicitly equivalent.

records.protocol_assertion: Central laboratory sample collected at every visit per the Laboratory Manual
records.downstream_assertion: [Extraction incomplete — page image was truncated during OCR]
records.rationale: The Laboratory Form could not be fully extracted; the visible content was cut off by a scanning defect, so this comparison is a processing/extraction defect rather than a content agreement or disagreement.
records.recommended_action: Re-scan or re-upload the Laboratory Form and re-run the mapping for this record.

coverage_limitations: One CRF Laboratory Form page was low-resolution and required OCR; the central laboratory collection procedure (FIND-0024) could not be fully extracted and is flagged as an ERROR requiring re-scan.
